AdminConfig.title: AdminConfig
AdminConfig.description: Stores admin credentials metadata and password hash for portfolio administration.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the admin.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the admin password.

email.description: Verified admin email for OTP recovery and password change.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin password was last updated.

AdminOtp.title: AdminOtp
AdminOtp.description: Stores single-use email OTP verification challenges for changing admin password.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID requesting the OTP.

email.description: Target email address for the OTP.

otpHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the 6-digit OTP code.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the OTP challenge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the OTP was issued.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the OTP was last updated.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores the admin credential configuration keyed by the admin user UID.

/admin_otps/{otpId}.description: Stores email OTP verification challenges for admin password updates.
